title: Fatal Fury Special
note: Neo Geo fighting game: health, timer.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Neo Geo 68000 RAM seen from 0x100000, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

credits.note: MVS credits (backup RAM), readable in MAME only

p1_mode.note: BIOS: player 1, 0 never played, 1 playing, 2 continue, 3 game over

bios_request.note: BIOS_USER_REQUEST: 2 demo, 3 title screen (asked by the BIOS when a coin goes in on an MVS)

bios_timer.note: BIOS_COMPULSION_TIMER: seconds left on the title screen before the game starts by itself

bios_mvs.note: BIOS_MVS_FLAG: 0 home console (AES, no coins), otherwise arcade (MVS)

health.note: player 1 health in %, full = 0x60; a K.O. can take it below zero, read 0xFF... and shown full before 1.31.1: from 0xB0 it reads empty (K.O. audit)

health_p2.note: player 2 health in %, full = 0x60; a K.O. can take it below zero, read 0xFF... and shown full before 1.31.1: from 0xB0 it reads empty (K.O. audit)

_time_sub.note: the timer's fraction of a second (RetroAchievements code notes, 0x92a Round Time Oscillator), it moves at every frame once the round's timer runs, FIGHT ! waits for it to come with the game's own FIGHT or GO (1.31.1)

score.note: player 1 score, BCD (RetroAchievements leaderboard "Best Players", rich presence and code notes, from tools/ra_notes.py), to confirm in game

score_p2.note: player 2 score, BCD (RetroAchievements leaderboard "Best Players", rich presence and code notes, from tools/ra_notes.py), to confirm in game

backdrop.note: backdrop of the fight (cheat database "Select Backdrop"): 1 USA (Terry), 2 Italy (Andy), 3 Thailand (Joe), 4 Australia (Bear), 5 Japan (Jubei), 6 Hong Kong (Cheng), 7 Korea (Kim), 8 Japan (Mai), 9 USA (Duck), 10 China (Tung), 11 Great Britain (Billy), 12 USA (Axel), 13 Spain (Laurence), 14 USA (Geese), 15 Germany (Krauser), 16 Japan (Ryo). Picks the HD theme in "hd": "stages"

round.note: round of the match, from 1 in the game, read from 0 (RetroAchievements code notes, 0xb2f0 [8bit] Number of Rounds, 0x01 = Round 1 ... 0x04 = FINAL ROUND), shown as ROUND n when a fight begins; to confirm in game (1.31.1, K.O. audit)

hd.note: HD screen theme for each backdrop value (index = value), see README, HD themes
